<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 211.0764, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈210.0691 Da. The formula that matches this exact mass most closely using common elements C, H, and O is C₁₄H₁₀O₂ (calculated mass = 210.0681 Da, within ~1 mDa of the observed value). No other reasonable combination of C, H, O, N, S, etc., fits as well. Therefore the molecular formula is C14H10O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H10O2</final_answer>
